M-GRADIENT-TEXTURES.Purpose: Deterministic Unity Texture2D factory for reusable linear, radial and conic gradient backgrounds.

Scope.SCP-IN-002: Cache of generated textures, released at the framework root teardown.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Widget-specific gradient Prop and arbitrary per-frame shader rendering.

Requirements.REQ-001: Inputs require positive bounded dimensions (each at most 4096 and at most 4194304 pixels) and at least one stop with finite position.
Requirements.REQ-002: Stops are clamped to [0,1] and stably sorted; equal positions preserve their input order.
Requirements.REQ-003: Linear angle, radial center/radius and conic start angle use top-down UI coordinates; output is an ordinary Texture2D for BackgroundImage.
Requirements.REQ-004: Equivalent parameters return the cached texture; live references are not evicted and ClearCache destroys cached textures at FlexVerseRoot teardown.
Requirements.REQ-005: Textures are generated on the Unity main thread, not in a background worker.

Inputs.IN-001: Gradient dimensions, kind-specific geometry and GradientStop array.

Outputs.OUT-001: Cached Texture2D instance suitable for BackgroundImage.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Allocates Unity Texture2D objects and destroys them on ClearCache.
